projects.title: GFA Exchange
projects.subtitle: Inclusive AI Loan Reallocation Engine
projects.summary: AI-driven loan reallocation sandbox for UK SME lending. Multi-agent system with privacy-preserving marketplace, LLM-powered explainability, and financial inclusion as a first-class metric. Honourable Mention at UKFinnovator by Ukfin+.

projects.title: PACTGuard
projects.subtitle: Pre-Release Compliance Middleware for AI-Era Financial Communications
projects.summary: RegTech middleware that reviews AI-generated financial communications and robo-advice before release. Compares three independent engines (deterministic rules, semantic retrieval, and a Gemini AI judge), then applies a Pass / Adjust / Check / Terminate decision with an evidence-bound explanation. Built for the Cambridge Spark 'Financial Regulation in an AI-Driven World' challenge.

projects.title: StudyBud
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Document Analysis & Quiz Generation
projects.summary: AI-powered tool for generating summaries and quizzes from documents. Features advanced NLP techniques for text extraction from PDF and DOCX files, integrated with OpenAI's language models.

projects.title: Train Booking System
projects.subtitle: A Clean Architecture .NET 8 train seat booking system
projects.summary: .NET 8 backend for booking train tickets, with seat availability checks, category-based pricing, and trip schedule management.

projects.title: MealSync
projects.subtitle: AI-Assisted Household Meal Planning Platform
projects.summary: AI-assisted household meal planning platform. Collaborative meal scheduling, recipe management, and automated grocery lists powered by Google Gemini. 77 automated tests, 93% AI service coverage. Built with FastAPI, React, and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: TicketSage
projects.subtitle: Movie Ticket Booking Platform
projects.summary: Django movie booking platform (TMDB, auth, showtimes) - group software engineering course competition winner at University of Ilorin; backend-led.

projects.title: EPrep
projects.subtitle: API-Driven Exam Preparation Platform
projects.summary: Student study app backend with parent-child management system, OTP-based phone verification, and structured learning content organization using Django REST Framework.

projects.title: Online Printing Service
projects.subtitle: Clean Architecture .NET Backend + Blazor Frontend
projects.summary: Document printing platform with .NET backend and Blazor frontend. Users upload files, pay online, receive a unique code, and retrieve their prints at a connected printing station.

projects.title: UK Shift Calculator
projects.subtitle: PWA for Shift Tracking & Pay Estimation
projects.summary: Progressive Web App for UK shift workers to log hours, calculate pay with 2024/25 tax and NI rates, and export payroll data. Includes offline support, weekend double pay, and CSV/JSON export.
